name: Sword Adept
effectText: When you attack with a weapon that has the Sword tag, the bonus momentum cost to use Swift Task to attack again is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0.

name: Blade Master 1
effectText: If you miss an attack with a weapon with the Sword tag and take the Swift Task to attack again the same turn, you may add a bonus die to your pool on the second attack.

name: Blade Master 2
effectText: When you use Swift Task to make an attack with the Sword tag, lower the Difficulty on that attack's roll by -1.

name: Into the Fray 1
effectText: Once a round, when you successfully defend using a weapon with the Sword tag against a melee attack, you may use a reaction to move up to your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Into the Fray 2
effectText: When you take the Sprint Major Action, you may also make an attack with a weapon with the Sword tag as part of this action, but only after you've finished your movement.

name: Parrying Master 1
effectText: You may perform two rerolls instead of one if you are wielding two items with the Parrying quality.

name: Parrying Master 2
effectText: While defending while wielding two weapons with the parrying quality, the complication range of your attacker is increased by 2.

name: Axe Adept
effectText: 1/turn, when wielding a weapon with the Axe tag, you can reroll any number of damage dice in your pool without spending bonus momentum.

name: Big Swing 1
effectText: When you miss on an attack while wielding a weapon with the Axe tag, you may reroll the attack against a different target within Reach.

name: Big Swing 2
effectText: If you choose to attack a target you successfully attacked with a weapon with the Axe tag in the previous round, you may reduce the Difficulty of that attack by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

name: Crusher 1
effectText: You may spend a Minor Action to give your next attack with a weapon with the Axe tag the Knockdown damage effect.

name: Crusher 2
effectText: When you successfully knock an enemy Prone using a weapon with the Axe tag, you gain 1 bonus momentum.

name: Guarding Axe 1
effectText: When you take the Block Minor Action while wielding a weapon with the Axe tag, you may also move up to half your speed.

name: Guarding Axe 2
effectText: When you take the Block Minor Action while wielding a weapon with the Axe tag, you or the target gains an additional 2[CD] Temporary HP.

name: Spear Adept
effectText: 1/turn when you make an attack with a weapon with the Spear tag, you may add a bonus die to your roll.

name: Long Reach 1
effectText: When you make a successful melee attack with a weapon with the Spear tag against a target that is not adjacent to you, you gain 1 bonus momentum.

name: Long Reach 2
effectText: When wielding a weapon with the Extended Quality, you may spend a Minor Action to give all melee attacks made against you +1 Difficulty until the start of your next turn. This benefit is lost if you cannot see your attacker or are prone.

name: Precise Piercer 1
effectText: Gain the following Minor Action: Pierce - While wielding a weapon with the Spear tag with two hands or with one hand free, you may spend a Minor Action to give your next attack the Piercing quality.

name: Precise Piercer 2
effectText: You may roll an additional number of [CD] equal to the weapon's base damage rating on an attack benefiting from the Pierce Minor Action.

name: Hold the Line 1
effectText: Whenever a character enters or takes any movement inside your Reach, you may make an Opportunity Attack against them.

name: Hold the Line 2
effectText: As a Minor Action while wielding a weapon with the Spear tag, you prepare yourself for an onslaught of enemies. You may use the Opportunity Attack reaction once every turn until the start of your next turn.

name: Bow Adept
effectText: While also wielding a weapon with the Bow tag, when you take the Aim Minor Action and reroll a die, you may choose between results.

name: Sniper 1
effectText: At the start of your turn, you may use a free action to become Immobilized until the start of your next turn. While Immobilized, your attacks with weapons with the Bow tag gain +3 Range.

name: Sniper 2
effectText: While Immobilized, you gain an extra +3[CD] on ranged attacks with weapons with the Bow tag.

name: Close Range Shooter 1
effectText: You ignore the Difficulty increase when making a ranged attack with a weapon with the Bow tag within the target's Reach. If you would already have this benefit (e.g. wielding a bow with the Close Quarters quality), you gain 1 bonus momentum after a successful attack with a weapon with the Bow tag against a target if you are within their Reach.

name: Close Range Shooter 2
effectText: When you succeed on a defense against ranged and melee weapon attacks, you may counterstrike with a weapon with the Bow tag.

name: Bowmaster 1
effectText: When you make an attack with a weapon with the Bow tag benefiting from the Aim Minor Action, you may choose to give the attack the Pinning damage effect or the Burst 1 quality.

name: Bowmaster 2
effectText: If you miss an attack with a weapon with the Bow tag benefiting from the Aim Minor Action, you gain a bonus die on your next bow attack.

name: Gauntlet Adept
effectText: You may spend a Minor Action in order to grant your next attack with a weapon with the Gauntlets tag the Knockdown damage effect.

name: Duck and Weave 1
effectText: After making a successful attack with a weapon with the Gauntlets tag, you may move either one space directly back from your target, or you may move through their space to an adjacent tile, without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Duck and Weave 2
effectText: When you make an attack with a weapon with the Gauntlets tag, successful or not, you may move up to 2 spaces away from your target, or you may move through their space to an adjacent tile and then move 1 additional space, without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Mean Right Hook 1
effectText: Your attacks with weapons with the Gauntlets tag also gain Knockback 1.

name: Mean Right Hook 2
effectText: 1/scene, you may use your Major Action to perform a Mighty Blow with a weapon with the Gauntlets tag. Make an attack, as normal. On a success, you double the amount of damage dice granted from your weapon (not the damage dice from your Skirmish), and your target gains the Dazed condition until the end of their next turn.

name: Unarmed Fighter 1
effectText: You may use your bare fists to attack. Your unarmed attacks are 0[CD] Gauntlet weapons (they only deal [CD] equal to your Skirmish). When you succeed on an unarmed attack, you generate 1 bonus momentum.

name: Unarmed Fighter 2
effectText: You may make two unarmed attacks as part of the same attack action if both hands are free.

name: Cavalry Adept
effectText: You do not suffer the Difficulty Increase for Tasks taken while mounted in combat. If you are wielding a weapon with the Saddleback quality, you gain 1 bonus momentum after a successful mounted attack.

name: Mounted Combatant 1
effectText: You may spend a Minor Action to give your Saddleback weapon the Knockdown damage effect. If your weapon already has this damage effect, instead you reduce the number of [!] needed to knock your target prone by -1.

name: Mounted Combatant 2
effectText: When making an attack with a Saddleback weapon while mounted, you gain a bonus die.

name: Spur 1
effectText: Your mounted speed is increased by 3. This does not apply to flying mounts.

name: Spur 2
effectText: For every 3 tiles you move in a row before making a melee attack while mounted, the attack gains an extra 1[CD] damage, up to a maximum of 4[CD].

name: Flier 1
effectText: You are able to ride a flying mount, and may Recall your mount as a Minor Action instead of a Major one.

name: Flier 2
effectText: Whenever you successfully evade or counter an attack while on a flying mount, you gain 2 bonus momentum.

name: Rapier Adept
effectText: Before or after you make an attack with a Rapier, you may perform one additional Minor Action without needing to spend bonus momentum if your other hand is free or holding an Effortless item.

name: Weapon of Authority 1
effectText: When you make a successful attack with a Rapier, you may nominate a single ally within line of sight, who receives a bonus die on their next Task.

name: Weapon of Authority 2
effectText: After you use your Major Action to attempt a Task using Authority, the cost of using a Swift Task to attack with a Rapier is reduced by 1 bonus Momentum, to a minimum of 0.

name: Fencer 1
effectText: After making an attack with your Rapier, the bonus Momentum cost to perform a Swift Task to attack with it again is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0.

name: Fencer 2
effectText: When wielding a Rapier in one hand and a Dagger in the other, you may apply the Effortless quality to the Dagger. In addition, when you successfully defend against an attack from an enemy while doing so, the Difficulty of your next attack against the attacker is reduced by 1.

name: Thrown Weapons Adept
effectText: When you make a successful attack with a weapon with the Thrown quality, you generate 1 bonus momentum.

name: Pinning Accuracy 1
effectText: Your attacks with weapons with the Thrown quality gain the Pinning damage effect.

name: Pinning Accuracy 2
effectText: If you Aim before making an attack with a weapon with the Thrown quality and the Pinning damage effect, the target is immobilized regardless of how many effects are rolled.

name: Create Some Distance 1
effectText: The range on your attack with weapons with the Thrown quality increases by 2. All weapons with the Thrown quality you wield gain an additional use before they are depleted.

name: Create Some Distance 2
effectText: When you take the Disengage Major Action, you may make an attack with a weapon with the Thrown quality as part of the same action. Weapons with the Thrown quality gain two further additional uses before they are depleted.

name: Antagonist
effectText: You deal an additional +2[CD] on a successful Demoralize task.

name: Flag of Dread 1
effectText: When you hold a Banner, you gain 1 bonus momentum on all successful Demoralize tasks and the range of your Demoralize increases by 3.

name: Flag of Dread 2
effectText: While holding a Banner, your Demoralize [CD] rolls gain the Terrifying damage effect.

name: Taunting 1
effectText: When you use Demoralize to deal more damage than the target's remaining Willpower, they take any leftover Willpower damage as HP Damage, ignoring Resistance.

name: Taunting 2
effectText: You may spend a Minor Action in order to target two enemies with your next Demoralize attack.

name: Bannerlord 1
effectText: You may wield a Banner without it taking up one of your hands (e.g. you can effectively fight with a Banner attached to a weapon, or to your armor), or, if wielding a Banner in one of your hands, you may reroll a die when attempting an Authority Task or using the Direct Major Action.

name: Bannerlord 2
effectText: When you succeed on an Authority Task while wielding a Banner or your target during the Direct Major Action is successful, you may also choose any number of allies within range equal to your Presence to receive one of the following benefits until the start of your next turn: Their Speed increases by 2. They gain 5 temporary HP. They gain +1[CD] on all damage rolls.

name: Bannerlord 3
effectText: When you succeed on an Authority Task while wielding a Banner or your target during the Direct Major Action is successful, you may also choose any number of allies within range equal to your Presence to use a reaction in order to move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Berserker 1
effectText: At the start of your turn, you may spend a Minor Action to go berserk. Until you end this effect as a free action at the start of your turn, you gain a bonus die on all melee attacks and deal +2[CD] damage on a successful attack. While berserk, you can not regain HP or WP, and all attacks against you gain a bonus die.

name: Berserker 2
effectText: You gain +2 speed while berserk, and your attacks gain the Terrifying damage effect.

name: Berserker 3
effectText: While berserk, all damage dealt to you is halved, and you gain a bonus die to defend against Demoralize Tasks.

name: Buckler Master 1
effectText: Your buckler counts as a weapon with the Gauntlet tag that deals 1[CD] Stunning damage.

name: Buckler Master 2
effectText: You can use your buckler to make an opening in your target's defenses. You may spend a Minor Action while wielding a buckler to decrease the Difficulty of your next attack with a different weapon by 1. Your buckler then loses the Parrying quality until the start of your next turn.

name: Buckler Master 3
effectText: You may keep the Parrying quality after using your buckler to create an opening.

name: Combat Medic
effectText: Whenever you attempt the First Aid Task during combat, you gain a bonus d20.

name: Healing Hands 1
effectText: You gain 1 bonus momentum on a successful First Aid task.

name: Healing Hands 2
effectText: When you make a successful First Aid Task, you roll [CD] equal to twice your Medicine Skill.

name: Field Doctor 1
effectText: When you attempt the First Aid Task, you may also remove a single negative Status affecting the target.

name: Field Doctor 2
effectText: After making a successful First Aid Task, you may choose to have you or the target of your First Aid Task move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Commander
effectText: You gain access to the Direct Major Action. When you take the Direct or Issue Orders Major Actions, you automatically generate 1 bonus momentum to spend on your turn.

name: Mastermind 1
effectText: 2/scene, when an ally attempts a Task, you may use your reaction to allow them to reroll all dice in their pool, but they must use the second result.

name: Mastermind 2
effectText: 1/round, when an ally within line of sight attempts a Task, you may use a reaction to Assist with your Presence + Authority.

name: Bark Orders 1
effectText: When you Direct an ally, they may reroll a single die in their pool when attempting the Task as part of that Direct.

name: Bark Orders 2
effectText: When you Direct an ally, they may perform a single Minor Action in addition to their Major Action. This may be done in either order.

name: Close Protection 1
effectText: When you take the Guard Action to protect someone else, until the start of your next turn, any time they move, you may move up to your speed maintaining adjacency to them. This does not apply to involuntary movement, and any movement you take in this way provokes opportunity attacks as normal.

name: Close Protection 2
effectText: When you take the move action on your turn, you may choose a willing adjacent ally to move with you. They may move up to their speed while remaining adjacent to you, and their movement does not trigger opportunity attacks, though your movement may.

name: Close Protection 3
effectText: 1/round when an adjacent ally is targeted by an attack, you may use your reaction to swap places with them, making yourself the target of the attack instead.

name: Defensive Stance 1
effectText: At the start of your turn, you may take a Defensive Stance as a Minor Action. While in a defensive stance, you gain 5 temporary HP that lasts until the start of your next turn or until depleted.

name: Defensive Stance 2
effectText: While in a defensive stance, you may choose between Agility, Brawn, or Coordination instead of the attack's default Attribute whenever you would make an Opposed Task to defend yourself against a melee attack.

name: Defensive Stance 3
effectText: While in a Defensive stance, all attacks made against you gain +1 Difficulty until the start of your next turn, but all your attacks also increase in Difficulty by +1.

name: Defensive Wall 1
effectText: After you take the Guard Major Action while wearing armor, you gain 1 bonus momentum.

name: Defensive Wall 2
effectText: Whenever you take the Guard Major Action while wearing armor, the Difficulty is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

name: Defensive Wall 3
effectText: While wearing armor, while taking actions, using abilities, or creating effects that depend on adjacency to your allies, all allies within Range 2 of you count as adjacent.

name: Demoralizing Attacker 1
effectText: Your attacks cut at your foes' will to fight. Gain the following Minor Action: Willbreaker - As a Minor Action, you give your next attack the Daunting 1 damage effect.

name: Demoralizing Attacker 2
effectText: Attacks you make against Characters with no Willpower gain +2[CD].

name: Demoralizing Attacker 3
effectText: Willbreaker gives the Daunting 2 damage effect instead of Daunting 1.

name: Dirty Fighter
effectText: Your first successful attack against an enemy in an encounter also inflicts the Slowed status until the end of the target's next turn.

name: Tricky Fighter 1
effectText: Gain the following Minor Action: Fiendish - As a Minor Action, you give your next attack Knockback 2.

name: Tricky Fighter 2
effectText: When you use the Fiendish Minor Action, your next attack also gains the Pinning damage effect.

name: Dogpile 1
effectText: If a character within your Reach is attacked by one of your allies, you can make an Opportunity Attack against this target as a reaction.

name: Dogpile 2
effectText: If you attack an opponent who has been successfully attacked by one of your allies in the past round, you gain a bonus d20 on your attack roll.

name: Dual Wielding
effectText: After making an attack, the bonus momentum cost to perform a Swift Task to attack with a different weapon is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0. When dual wielding, one or both of the weapons being wielded must be 1H, and the character must choose which weapon they are attacking with before making the roll for the Task.

name: Double Blow 1
effectText: 1/scene when wielding two weapons with the Axe tag at once, as a Major Action you may strike with both in one powerful attack, rolling to hit only once but dealing the damage of both weapons. You may not perform a Swift Task this turn.

name: Double Blow 2
effectText: When you defeat an enemy using Double Blow 1, you gain a bonus die on your next attack.

name: Whirlwind 1
effectText: When wielding two weapons with the Sword tag, you may spend a Minor Action to give your next attack the Burst 1 quality.

name: Whirlwind 2
effectText: When wielding two weapons with the Sword tag, you may spend your Determination to use the Attack action to make two attacks, one with each weapon. If you use a Swift Task to attack again on the same turn, you may attack twice more, once with each weapon.

name: Duelist 1
effectText: 1/scene, as a Minor Action you may challenge a single enemy within line of sight on the battlefield to a duel, giving them Duelist's Mark. While an enemy has Duelist's Mark, you gain 2 bonus momentum on successful melee attacks against them, but +1 Difficulty on attacks against any other target. Duelist's Mark lasts until the marked enemy is defeated, or until you drop the mark as a free action at the beginning of your turn.

name: Duelist 2
effectText: An enemy marked with Duelist's Mark can't voluntarily move away from you and you can't voluntarily move away from them, unless either of you takes the disengage Major Action.

name: Duelist 3
effectText: Enemy marked with Duelist's Mark gain +1 Difficulty on attacks against targets other than you. Additionally, when an enemy with Duelist's Mark is defeated, you may immediately apply it to a new target within line of sight as a free action.

name: Feint 1
effectText: Gain the following Minor Action: Feint - As a Minor Action, you declare a Feint against a target. Your next melee attack against them uses Intrigue instead of Skirmish for calculating your target number and the attack's damage. Your target must do the same or you gain a bonus die on the attack.

name: Feint 2
effectText: When you take the Feint Minor Action, you may also replace your weapon's base damage with [CD] equal to your Intrigue on your next attack.

name: Feint 3
effectText: You may Feint as a Free Action if an ally is adjacent to the target.

name: Fortified Mind 1
effectText: When targeted by a Demoralize Task, you may reroll a single die in your dice pool to defend against it.

name: Fortified Mind 2
effectText: Your Willpower maximum increases by +3.

name: Fortified Mind 3
effectText: 1/round, when targeted by a Demoralize Task, you may reduce the damage by an amount equal to your Skirmish as a reaction.

name: Heavy Lifting 1
effectText: You ignore the increase in Difficulty when wielding a two-handed weapon in one hand.

name: Heavy Lifting 2
effectText: Gain the following Minor Action: Demolish - As a Minor Action, you grant your next attack the Burst 1 damage effect.

name: Heavy Lifting 3
effectText: Your Heavy weapons gain Reliable 3. In addition, when you take the Demolish Minor Action, your attack also gains the Destructive damage effect.

name: Helping Hand 1
effectText: When you use the Assist Major Action, you immediately gain two Bonus Momentum to spend during your Turn.

name: Helping Hand 2
effectText: When you use the Assist Major Action, the assisted character may re-roll one die.

name: Helping Hand 3
effectText: When you use the Assist Major Action, you may roll two dice instead of one on your Assist.

name: Hunter Seeker 1
effectText: You may add your Skirmish to your Awareness when calculating the range for the Search Major Action.

name: Hunter Seeker 2
effectText: 1/scene, as a free action you may choose a single enemy unit within line of sight to mark as the target of your hunt, marking them as your Quarry. While an enemy is marked as your quarry, the Difficulty of any Search actions to find them is lowered by 1, and once per attack, you may reroll any number of [CD] in your pool without spending bonus Momentum when dealing damage after a successful attack against your quarry.

name: Hunter Seeker 3
effectText: Enemies marked as quarry cannot benefit from the Invisible condition when attacking or defending against you. Additionally, you may take the Search Action as a Minor Action on your turn.

name: Icon
effectText: You may use Console as a Minor Action.

name: Flag of Victory 1
effectText: When you hold a banner, the range of your Console Tasks increases by 3 and you can target up to 2 Characters when you Console.

name: Flag of Victory 2
effectText: All characters within range equal to your Authority have a bonus d20 when defending against Demoralize Tasks, and they gain Willpower equal to your Authority when they start their turn within this range.

name: Reassurance 1
effectText: When you successfully use Console to restore an ally's Willpower, you may also restore your own Willpower for an amount equal to your Authority.

name: Reassurance 2
effectText: When you successfully Console an ally, you may also remove one non-self-inflicted Status or Condition afflicting them. Rattled cannot be removed in this way.

name: Impenetrable 1
effectText: Foes trigger opportunity attacks from you even when they take the Disengage Major Action.

name: Impenetrable 2
effectText: When you hit a target with an opportunity attack, you may also Immobilize them until the start of their next turn.

name: Impenetrable 3
effectText: When you Immobilize a target, you may also move them 1 tile in any direction.

name: Insurmountable 1
effectText: Enemies have +1 Difficulty when attempting to Grapple you. You have -1 Difficulty on Tasks to escape a grapple.

name: Insurmountable 2
effectText: You gain access to the Stand Firm Reaction: Stand Firm - 1/round, as a Reaction, when an attack or hazard would knock you Prone, you may ignore it and stay standing.

name: Insurmountable 3
effectText: You may use the Stand Firm Reaction to ignore Forced Movement and stay in place. If an attack would knock you Prone and force you to move, you may use Stand Firm to ignore both.

name: Juggernaut 1
effectText: When you succeed on a Shove action, you may move the target up to 3 spaces instead of 1.

name: Juggernaut 2
effectText: When you successfully Shove an enemy and push them into an obstacle that stops their movement, you may deal 3[CD] damage to them.

name: Juggernaut 3
effectText: Your successful Shove actions deal [CD] damage equal to your Skirmish. Additionally, when you succeed on a Shove action, you may move with the target you shove to remain adjacent to them as part of the same action.

name: Mage's Bane 1
effectText: When an enemy casts a spell, you may use a reaction to make an Opportunity Attack against them if they are within Reach, or move up to your full speed towards them if they are not.

name: Mage's Bane 2
effectText: 3/scene, you may use the Silence Major Action. Silence (Range 10): Make an Opposed Task against an enemy within Range, using Presence + Diplomacy vs. the target's Awareness + Study. On a success, the target cannot cast spells until the end of their next turn.

name: Mage's Bane 3
effectText: When you succeed on an Opportunity Attack as part of Mage's Bane, you may choose to inflict one of the following effects on your target, potentially disrupting their spell: they are knocked prone, they are pushed up to 3 spaces away from you, or they are Immobilized until the end of their next turn.

name: Opportunist 1
effectText: When you make an Opportunity Attack, you may reroll one of your dice, keeping the second result.

name: Opportunist 2
effectText: Gain the following Major Action: Blockade - Until the start of your next turn, all Opportunity Attacks you make deal an additional +2[CD] damage.

name: Opportunist 3
effectText: When you take the Blockade Major Action, you make all Opportunity Attacks with -1 Difficulty until the start of your next turn.

name: Overwhelming 1
effectText: When you reduce an enemy's Willpower to 0, you may also move that unit a number of spaces equal to half your Diplomacy. This counts as involuntary movement.

name: Overwhelming 2
effectText: When you reduce an enemy's Willpower to 0, you may also inflict the Immobilized condition on them, which lasts until the end of their next turn or until they are no longer Rattled.

name: Overwhelming 3
effectText: When you attempt a Task that targets an enemy with no Willpower, the Difficulty is reduced by 1.

name: Poisoner 1
effectText: Gain the following Minor Action: Poison - As a Minor Action, you apply the Persistent 2 damage effect to one of your weapons. This lasts until you successfully attack with it or until the start of your next turn.

name: Poisoner 2
effectText: Persistent damage from the Poison Minor Action increases to 3, and characters suffering any Persistent damage inflicted by you have +1 Difficulty on their Task to remove it.

name: Poisoner 3
effectText: Persistent damage from the Poison Minor Action increases to 4, and you generate 2 bonus momentum when you make a successful attack against an enemy with Persistent damage that you've inflicted.

name: Provocateur 1
effectText: You may spend a Minor Action to give your next attack or Demoralize the Provoking damage effect.

name: Provocateur 2
effectText: You gain a bonus d20 against enemies that are Enraged at you.

name: Provocateur 3
effectText: You deal +1[CD] damage against enemies that are Enraged at you, and reduce the damage from their attacks against you by 1.

name: Rally 1
effectText: You gain the following Rally Minor Action which you may use 2/scene: Rally - As a Minor Action, you grant one ally within line of sight a bonus die to use on a Task. Allies cannot benefit from multiple instances of this Task at once.

name: Rally 2
effectText: You may use the Rally action as a reaction at the start of an ally's turn. You may use Rally a number of times per scene equal to your Authority.

name: Rally 3
effectText: You gain 2 additional uses of Rally. When you use Rally on an ally, they may choose to forgo the bonus die in order to gain +2 bonus momentum to use on their turn instead.

name: Rapport 1
effectText: Choose one character with whom your character has a special or significant rapport. Whenever you are adjacent to them, you may take the Assist action as a Minor Action but only to support that character. You may change the target of your rapport between sessions or during narrative play, but only if it is narratively appropriate.

name: Rapport 2
effectText: 1/round, if the character with your rapport is targeted by a hostile action, you may use your reaction to move half your speed towards them.

name: Rapport 3
effectText: 1/round, when the character with your rapport is adjacent to you and is dealt damage, you may reduce the damage by half, and you also take an equivalent amount of damage.

name: Resilient 1
effectText: Your Health Bar increases by 2 (which increases your Max HP by 6).

name: Resilient 2
effectText: When another character would roll dice in order to restore your HP, they gain +1[CD] and may reroll any number of [CD] in their pool.

name: Resilient 3
effectText: When you use the Avoid Injury Determination Spend, you regain half your max HP.

name: Shield Master
effectText: When you take the Block Minor Action while wielding an item with the Shield quality, you gain +2 temporary HP when an effect is rolled instead of +1.

name: Shield Bash 1
effectText: You may wield any item with the Shield quality as a 1[CD] gauntlet with Knockback 1. As a Minor Action, you may ready your shield to increase this to Knockback 2.

name: Shield Bash 2
effectText: When you ready your shield, your shield's attack also gains the Stunning damage effect.

name: Shield Wall 1
effectText: 1/round, when an adjacent ally is targeted by an attack while you are wielding an item with the Shield quality, as a reaction you may assist them on their defense roll with your Agility, Brawn, or Coordination + Skirmish.

name: Shield Wall 2
effectText: Any item you wield with the Shield quality gains the Effortless quality. Once per round you may reroll the extra die your shield grants. Additionally, 1/scene while you are wielding a shield and you are hit by an attack, you may destroy your shield to ignore all damage/effects from the attack.

name: Skirmisher 1
effectText: When an opponent attacks you using an Opportunity Attack, you may inflict damage if you win the contested check.

name: Skirmisher 2
effectText: 1/round, when an opponent targets you with an attack, you may use a reaction to make a melee attack against them first which occurs before their attack is resolved. If you miss, your opponent does not deal any damage.

name: Skirmisher 3
effectText: 1/round, you may cause an attack taken against you as a reaction to automatically miss. This must be declared before any dice for the attack are rolled.

name: Sleepytime 1
effectText: You may spend a Minor Action to apply the Stunning damage effect to your next melee attack.

name: Sleepytime 2
effectText: When you make a successful attack with a weapon that has the Knockdown damage effect, you automatically knock your opponent Prone, regardless of [!] rolled.

name: Sleepytime 3
effectText: You gain an extra d20 against Prone or Immobilized opponents.

name: Stealthy Fighter 1
effectText: 1/turn, after you successfully take the Attack action, you may Hide as a Minor Action.

name: Stealthy Fighter 2
effectText: When you make an attack while hidden, you may choose to apply one of the following effects to the target: Knockdown, Startling, or Terrifying.

name: Stealthy Fighter 3
effectText: When you use Stealthy Fighter 2, you may choose two effects instead of one.

name: Swift Steps 1
effectText: When you take the Sprint Action while unmounted, you may reduce the Bonus Momentum cost of Swift Task on the same turn by 1, to a minimum of 0.

name: Swift Steps 2
effectText: While unmounted, you ignore the effects of difficult terrain, and moving while Prone costs 2 speed per tile of movement, instead of 3.

name: Swift Steps 3
effectText: While unmounted, you may take the Move Minor Action twice each turn.

name: Tactician
effectText: You gain 2 bonus momentum after taking the Pinpoint Major Action. You also gain access to the Direct Major Action.

name: Spotter 1
effectText: When you Pinpoint an enemy, you may force them to make an opposed Task with their Reason/Study vs. your Reason/Study. On a success, you may afflict them with one of the following effects: The target is Exposed until the start of their next turn. The next successful attack made against the target gains +2[CD]. The next attack made against the target may reroll one of the dice in their pool.

name: Spotter 2
effectText: When using the Direct Action or issuing an army Order, you may use Reason instead of Presence. You also gain an additional effect to choose from when using Spotter 1: The next successful attack made against the target also deals WP damage equal to half of the damage rolled.

name: Studied Combatant 1
effectText: Once a round, as a Minor Action, you can learn one of the following things about a single enemy within line of sight: their attributes and skills scores, their speed, or their current HP and current resistance.

name: Studied Combatant 2
effectText: When you use the Studied Combatant Minor Action, you learn all three options instead of choosing one. In addition, you may use this ability as a reaction when an enemy finishes their turn within your line of sight, but still are limited to using it once a round.

name: Trapper 1
effectText: 3/scene, you can set one of the following traps for an enemy. As a Minor Action, you can choose a tile you can see within a range equal to your Awareness and set a trap there that lasts until triggered or the end of the scene. This trap is undetectable to enemies unless they succeed on a Search Major Action to discover it. Spring Trap: knocked back 4 spaces in a direction of your choice. Steel Trap: Immobilized until the end of their next turn. Net Trap: ensnared, and cannot take any actions until they or an ally spends their Major Action to escape the trap, though they may continue moving if they have any movement remaining.

name: Trapper 2
effectText: You can set a number of traps per scene equal to twice your Intrigue, and may set two traps at a time as part of one Minor Action.

name: Trapper 3
effectText: When an enemy triggers one of your traps, they also take a number of [CD] damage equal to your Intrigue.

name: Unarmored Master 1
effectText: When you successfully defend against an attack while not wearing armor or wielding a shield or buckler, you generate 2 bonus momentum.

name: Unarmored Master 2
effectText: While not wearing armor or wielding a shield or buckler, you can stand from prone as part of the Move Minor Action using half your movement. In addition, your Speed is increased by 2.

name: Unarmored Master 3
effectText: While not wearing armor or wielding a shield or buckler, 1/round you may use a reaction to impose +1 Difficulty on an attack made against you. In addition, your Speed is increased by 3 instead of 2.

name: Vengeful
effectText: When you successfully attack an opponent who has damaged you during the current round, you generate 2 bonus momentum.

name: Desperation 1
effectText: When you have at least one wound, the first attack you make on your turn deals an additional +2 Willpower damage to your opponent.

name: Desperation 2
effectText: When you have two wounds, the first attack you make on your turn deals an additional +3[CD].

name: Retribution 1
effectText: When you successfully attack an opponent who has damaged you or one of your allies during the current round, you may reroll 3[CD] without cost.

name: Retribution 2
effectText: Once per round, when one of your allies is successfully hit by an attack, you may use a reaction to move up to your speed and make an attack against the attacker.

name: War Healer 1
effectText: When you take the First Aid Major Action, the bonus Momentum cost to perform a Swift Task to make an attack on the same turn is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0.

name: War Healer 2
effectText: Once per round, when you make a successful attack, you may heal an adjacent ally for an amount equal to your Medicine.

name: War Healer 3
effectText: Once per round, when you use an action or ability to heal an ally, you may also regain HP equal to half of what your ally regained.

name: Willing Shield 1
effectText: Once per session, before entering combat, you may choose one of your allies. Once per round, when that ally within your Reach is targeted by an attack, as a reaction you may assist them on their defense roll with your Weapon's Attribute + Skirmish.

name: Willing Shield 2
effectText: If you use Willing Shield to assist your targeted ally but the attacker succeeds anyways, your ally reduces the damage of the attack by 2.

name: Willing Shield 3
effectText: 1/scene, when you use Willing Shield to assist an adjacent ally and the attacker succeeds anyways, you may take the attack instead, suffering any damage and additional effects.

name: Disgraced Shield 1
effectText: If the target of your Willing Shield dies, any and all of your Willing Shield talents are replaced with their Disgraced Shield counterparts (you may also choose to start with Disgraced Shield talents as part of your character's backstory). Once per session, you must choose one of your allies. Once per round, when that ally is successfully attacked while they are adjacent to you, you may use a reaction to shield them by taking the attack instead, suffering any damage and additional effects in their place.

name: Disgraced Shield 2
effectText: After using the Disgraced Shield reaction, on your next turn, your attacks against the attacker that triggered the reaction gain +2[CD]. If you use a Swift Task to attack this opponent, your bonus momentum cost to do so is reduced to 1.

name: Disgraced Shield 3
effectText: If you use Disgraced Shield to take an attack that would cause you to drop to 0HP, you may ignore the attack's damage. You may do this once per combat. In addition, if you use Disgraced Shield to take an attack that reduces you to 0HP and you choose to die, you gain a bonus die on all Tasks you attempt during your final Turn.

name: Wrestler 1
effectText: When you attempt the Grapple Major Action, you may roll using either Brawn, Agility, or Coordination as your Attribute. The target of your grapple defends using the same Attribute.

name: Wrestler 2
effectText: You gain a bonus die when attacking a target who is grappled. Additionally, you can use reactions while grappling an opponent.

name: Wrestler 3
effectText: When you make a successful melee attack against a character, you may attempt to Grapple them as a Minor Action.
